items.title: Repository quality gates pass
items.precondition: Run from the recorded accessibility worktree with dependencies installed.
steps: Run the configured TypeScript check.
Run lint, production build, and mock-data validation.
Check the diff for whitespace errors and disallowed fixed text utilities.
items.expected: All required gates exit successfully, with no new lint errors or disallowed typography utilities.
items.evidence: TypeScript, build, mock validation, and git diff checks exited 0. Lint exited 0 with existing warnings only. Static inventory found zero non-print fixed-pixel text utilities and zero truncation utilities.
items.notes: The repository does not define check:all or check:conventions scripts, so the documented project gates were used.

items.title: Display preferences scale text and persist
items.precondition: Open the app with browser storage enabled.
steps: Open Display Settings before authentication.
Select Standard, Large, and Extra Large text.
Reload, sign in, sign out, and reset demo data.
Enable Enhanced Contrast and Reduced Motion.
items.expected: Text scales to 100%, 112.5%, and 125%. Every preference persists through the approved lifecycle.
items.evidence: Automated browser acceptance verified 16px, 18px, and 20px body values, pre-auth settings, persistence, and demo reset behavior. Static contrast checks passed the specified thresholds.
items.notes: Account synchronization remains outside this release.

items.title: Map and accessible Lot List stay aligned
items.precondition: Sign in with the deterministic demo account and open Map.
steps: Apply representative map filters.
Switch from Map to List.
Inspect the result announcement and 25-item page.
Open a permitted lot, close its details, and return to Map.
items.expected: Map and List share scoped results. Restricted fields stay hidden, and focus returns to the opening action.
items.evidence: Automated browser acceptance verified 25-item pagination, permission-safe rows, detail focus, focus return, view persistence, and Map restoration.
items.notes: The map canvas remains a visual enhancement; the Lot List is the nonvisual path.

items.title: Core forms expose usable invalid states
items.precondition: Open Login, Sales and Payments, and Burials with the demo data set.
steps: Submit Login with invalid input.
Attempt the representative Sales hold flow with missing data.
Advance the representative Burials form with missing data.
items.expected: Each form identifies invalid fields, associates guidance, and announces the actionable error state.
items.evidence: Automated browser acceptance verified Login alerts and field associations, the Sales required combobox and disabled submit state, and Burials error announcements.
items.notes: The acceptance run covered representative failure paths without changing business rules.

items.title: Routes reflow across approved sizes
items.precondition: Sign in and use the registered application routes.
steps: Open each registered route at every text preference.
Check the three core workflows at desktop, laptop, and both tablet orientations.
Check Map and List at an effective 320 CSS-pixel width.
Use the narrow-layout navigation sheet.
items.expected: No route crashes or creates document overflow. Essential controls remain reachable and meet the approved target floor.
items.evidence: Automated browser acceptance passed 11 routes at three text sizes, four representative viewports, tablet navigation, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, and shared target-size checks.
items.notes: The browser run completed 95 checks without uncaught page errors.

items.title: Map editor geometry remains aligned
items.precondition: Sign in with permission to open the map editor.
steps: Run the map editor alignment check.
Run the guided map editor browser smoke test.
items.expected: The readability changes preserve editor alignment, layered controls, and existing geometry behavior.
items.evidence: qa/map-editor-alignment.ts and qa/map-editor-layered-smoke.mjs both passed against the isolated worktree runtime.
items.notes: Dense 24px geometry handles remain an approved canvas exception.

items.title: Keyboard, zoom, theme, and success-path review
items.precondition: Use a desktop browser with the demo account and a visible focus indicator.
steps: Complete all three core workflows using only the keyboard.
Repeat representative routes at 200% browser zoom.
Check Standard and Enhanced Contrast in light and dark themes.
Complete representative success paths for Sales and Burials.
items.expected: Focus order, focus return, reflow, contrast presentation, and success feedback remain usable without clipped essential actions.
items.notes: Record browser, operating system, text preference, contrast mode, result, and screenshots.

items.title: NVDA and Chrome representative review
items.precondition: Use current NVDA with Chrome on Windows and the demo account.
steps: Check skip navigation and route announcements.
Operate Map and Lot List without the canvas.
Complete representative Sales and Burials form checks.
items.expected: Names, roles, states, result updates, errors, and focus changes are announced clearly.
items.notes: Record Windows, Chrome, and NVDA versions, plus text and contrast preferences.

items.title: VoiceOver and Safari iPad review
items.precondition: Use VoiceOver with Safari on an iPad and the demo account.
steps: Check settings and navigation in portrait orientation.
Operate Map and Lot List in both orientations.
Complete representative Sales and Burials form checks.
items.expected: Touch exploration and swipe navigation expose clear names, states, errors, and reachable actions in both orientations.
items.notes: Record iPad, iPadOS, Safari, and VoiceOver versions, plus text and contrast preferences.

items.title: TalkBack and Chrome Android review
items.precondition: Use TalkBack with Chrome on Android and the demo account.
steps: Check settings and navigation in portrait orientation.
Operate Map and Lot List in both orientations.
Complete representative Sales and Burials form checks.
items.expected: Touch exploration and swipe navigation expose clear names, states, errors, and reachable actions in both orientations.
items.notes: Record device, Android, Chrome, and TalkBack versions, plus text and contrast preferences.
